# ScribeCat 0.25.6

## Fixed
- Stabilize PDF pinch/trackpad zoom around the actual pointer on desktop and mobile.
- Minimize an inline PDF viewer automatically when the same PDF is opened in split view.
- Add PDF single-page and all-pages views, with two columns on wide screens.
- Use a single-square icon for single view and a four-square icon for multi view.
- Render PowerPoint previews through the slide renderer so text and images stay together.
- Show two PowerPoint slides side-by-side on wide screens.

## Docker
- Publish `ghcr.io/reidar96/scribecat-server:0.25.6`.
- Pin the Server Edition Compose defaults to `0.25.6`.
